subject: Request: Temporary billing waiver for latency surge impacting production
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@stratus.health>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stratus Ops <ops@stratus.health>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:14:32 -0800
Subject: Production impact + request for billing waiver

Hi Kimberly,

We had a sharp latency spike on Tuesday morning between 03:30–06:00 UTC that significantly affected our inference throughput (p50 moved from ~120ms to ~2.3s). Our engineering team had to shift traffic and apply temporary throttles; customer-facing features degraded during a key morning window.

We appreciate the incident summary you sent earlier, but given the customer impact, Stratus is requesting a temporary billing waiver for the usage incurred during that window and a one-time credit to offset the outage. Can you confirm whether Redwood can waive charges for the affected hours and provide a path for a formal compensation? We need a concise plan to present to our CFO.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Platform Engineering, Stratus Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@stratus.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:05:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Production impact + request for billing waiver

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear summary and for flagging the business impact. I’m escalating this internally to finance and AE to get a concession proposal together quickly.

Short answer: we can propose a temporary billing waiver plus a usage credit tied to the impacted window, but I need signoff from RevOps/Finance for any dollar amount. I’m including Marissa (AE) and Jonas (Finance) to draft the offer.

Next steps I propose:
- Internal concession proposal (today)
- Finance review and exec signoff (within 24–48 hours)
- Confirmed terms and DocuSign for the credit agreement

I’ll follow up once we have the numbers. Appreciate your patience.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:10:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Production impact + request for billing waiver (internal proposal)

Team — internal proposal attached (proposed_concession_calc.xlsx) and a short incident timeline (incident_timeline.pdf). Quick summary of recommended concession: 

- Temporary billing waiver for the 2.5 hour surge window (waive consumption charges for impacted tokens during 2027-11-02 03:30–06:00 UTC).
- One-time invoice credit equal to 25% of Stratus’s billed usage for the affected billing period (this balances goodwill + ARR protection).
- One complimentary month of dedicated support (no charge) to help stabilize their rollout.
- Commitment: We will prioritize a performance engineering slot to tune their model routing for free for two sprints.

Rationale: preserves relationship ahead of renewal, proportional to estimated customer harm, and avoids setting an open-ended precedent. Numbers in the spreadsheet show the total ~$42k gross credit exposure under this structure (given current usage patterns).

Please review and surface any items that require exec escalation. Hoping Jonas can confirm the accounting treatment and Vivek can approve the path if needed.

-Marissa
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 12:45:19 -0800
Subject: Re: Production impact + request for billing waiver (finance review)

Thanks team — reviewed the attached calc. Accounting notes: a 25% one-time credit and the waived hours should be processed as contra-revenue for Q4; exposure estimated at ~$42,300. This is acceptable from a finance perspective if we get VP approval for goodwill credits over $25k.

Vivek — can you confirm executive signoff on: (A) waiver of consumption charges for the specific outage window, (B) 25% invoice credit, and (C) one month complimentary support? If you approve, I’ll draft the concession memo and a short addendum for signature (DocuSign link to follow).

If exec wants a smaller exposure, alternate path: 15% credit + waived hours would reduce cost to ~$28k. Please advise.

-Jonas
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@stratus.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 11:22:07 -0800
Subject: Re: Production impact + request for billing waiver

Daniel — thanks again for your patience. Executive team has approved the following concession: 

1) Waiver of consumption charges for the affected window (2027-11-02 03:30–06:00 UTC).
2) One-time invoice credit equal to 20% of Stratus’s billed usage for the impacted billing period (final exposure ~$34k).
3) One complimentary month of dedicated support focused on routing/performance tuning.

Jonas drafted the concession memo; I’ve initiated the DocuSign and included the concession calculation and incident timeline (links below). Please review and sign the addendum to confirm acceptance. Once signed, we’ll apply the credit to your next invoice and schedule the support engagement.

DocuSign (concession addendum): https://docusign.com/embedded/signing/ABC12345
Incident timeline & calc: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/incident-7843

If this is acceptable, sign and I’ll confirm next steps with our engineering team to start the performance work first thing next week.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_concession_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet), incident_timeline.pdf (timeline)
